# Requirements-quality Checklist: Device-local Family and AI-guided Setup

**Purpose**: Review whether the local family directory, multi-child setup, role return, and bounded
AI-personalization requirements are complete, precise, safe, and testable.
**Created**: 2026-09-06
**Feature**: [Feature 003 specification](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` workflow based on the
current feature context and user requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. Mark an item `[x]`
only when a reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the requirements were reviewed and found sufficient; it does not
mean implementation work is complete.

## Local data boundary

- [ ] CHK001 Is the single-household, device-local demo boundary explicitly distinguished from
      production accounts, authentication, encryption, cloud backup, and cross-device sync?
- [ ] CHK002 Are persisted entities, schema version, adapters, restoration timing, and the exact
      non-persisted task/reward/garden authorities stated without ambiguity?
- [ ] CHK003 Are corruption, unknown version, unavailable storage, failed save, idempotent retry,
      pairing revocation, and reset outcomes independently testable?
- [ ] CHK004 Does reset explicitly clear both the family receipt and paired markers before exposing
      signed-out entry again?

## Roles and setup sequence

- [ ] CHK005 Is the supported role/profile cardinality exactly one Parent and one or two configured
      Children, with internal synthetic slot limits explained?
- [ ] CHK006 Does the sequence define Child count before exactly one indexed form per Child, Back
      preservation, whole-family review, and save-before-authentication ordering?
- [ ] CHK007 Are required and optional Child fields clearly separated, bounded, and validated?
- [ ] CHK008 Do requirements deny unconfigured profiles at every Parent/Child selector and direct
      access path without changing active identity?
- [ ] CHK009 Is returning-Parent and returning-Child behavior explicit across reload, first pairing,
      stored pairing, revocation, sign-out, and deterministic reset?

## AI and child safety

- [ ] CHK010 Are the personalization inputs an exhaustive allowlist that excludes gender,
      nickname, family name, contact data, free text, media, task history, diagnosis, and emotion?
- [ ] CHK011 Are output shape, deterministic/prepared origin, fallibility disclosure, opt-out, and
      Parent decision authority measurable?
- [ ] CHK012 Does the AI sparkle/star requirement bind the icon to labeled bounded functionality
      without implying live inference, open chat, companionship, or autonomous task approval?
- [ ] CHK013 Are gender choices optional, non-inferred, non-ranking, non-recommendation, and
      non-gendered-copy inputs?

## Bilingual experience and evidence

- [ ] CHK014 Are Arabic-first RTL and equivalent English LTR copy, logical layout, mixed-script
      names, long labels, 48dp targets, keyboard scrolling, 200% text, and reduced motion covered?
- [ ] CHK015 Are automated, compact browser, production export, physical Android, TalkBack/Back/IME,
      and named-human review gates separated so proxy evidence cannot overclaim native acceptance?
- [ ] CHK016 Are local/prepared/synthetic labels required at the point of use and preserved in the
      demo script, limitations, architecture, and release-review packet?

## Notes

- Leave items unchecked until an independent requirements reviewer evaluates them.
- Implementation completion is tracked in `tasks.md`, not by these markers.
